01 / THE CHALLENGE

The challenge

An early venture needs a repeatable way to identify and engage potential institutional partners. The first challenge was deciding where to focus.

02 / THE APPROACH

The approach

Prioritised more than 30 academic institutions and developed the venture’s first partner pipeline and outreach process.

03 / WHAT CHANGED

What changed

Established an initial institutional pipeline and a structured outreach process. Partnership conversion and revenue outcomes are not reported in the source resume.

THE TAKEAWAY

A pipeline is a set of choices about focus. Prioritisation makes an early team’s limited time more intentional.
